chosen.title: Bayesian Curls: How to in 3 MINUTES - for Maximum Bicep Growth!
chosen.description:
Bayesian curl form, how to do Bayesian curls, and the most common mistakes to avoid — this tutorial shows you how to isolate your biceps, maximize tension, and build stronger, fuller arms with perfect cable curl technique. If your curls feel ineffective or you’re losing tension at the top or bottom of the movement, this guide fixes it step by step.

The Bayesian curl primarily targets the biceps brachii, emphasizing full-range contraction and stretch for maximum growth. By setting the cable at wrist height and standing with a staggered stance, you maintain constant tension throughout the movement while protecting your elbows and shoulders. In this video, you’ll learn setup, elbow positioning, proper range of motion, and advanced variations to fully engage your biceps.

👉 Watch next: https://youtu.be/Qzazduk0Y3U

🎯 In this video, you’ll learn:

Perfect Bayesian curl form from setup to full contraction

How to position your cable and stagger your stance for maximum tension

Why keeping your elbow tucked prevents cheating and isolates the bicep

Rep ranges for growth (12–20 reps per arm)

Advanced tweaks: both arms at once, partial rep finishers

Common mistakes: cutting ROM short, leaning too far forward, or letting elbows drift

Tips for long-head bicep activation and control

candidates.title: ✅ The PERFECT Bayesian Curl (DO THIS!)
candidates.description:
✅ The PERFECT Bayesian Curl Form Tips

1️⃣ Set the cable handle at elbow height – A higher handle position provides a greater biceps stretch than a lower setup. It also helps keep your elbows from drifting forward and improves stability.

2️⃣ Keep your elbows behind your torso – As far as your mobility allows, maintain this position to maximize the biceps stretch.

3️⃣ Lean slightly forward – This enhances stability and reduces the chance of your elbows creeping forward. Avoid standing completely upright.

4️⃣ Maintain a neutral wrist – Keep your wrist in line with your forearm throughout the movement.

5️⃣ Depress your shoulders – Keep them down the entire time to prevent your traps from taking over. In other words, don’t shrug!
